scope: Staging and read-only source inspection only; actual release upgrade not launched

textBehavior.startDefault: No; d prints actual removal/add/upgrade details via sensible-pager
textBehavior.configuration: Interactive dpkg changes need per-file review; existing configuration default is keep
textBehavior.obsoleteCleanup: Explicit choice; defer optional cleanup until rebooted GPU/SSH/GUI and package identity validation
textBehavior.modeFlag: Accepted by Jammy wrapper but explicitly deprecated/ignored in Noble payload; serverMode inferred from cache
textBehavior.preconfirmImpact: Full release-upgrader preparation rewrites repositories and fetches target indexes before plan confirmation; staging-only inspection is not a removal-plan dry run.

sshRecovery.detection: _sshMagic requires /proc process ancestry containing sshd; it does not test SSH_CONNECTION
sshRecovery.tmuxAndSystemd: Detached multiplexer/system unit normally reparents toPID1; do not assume auto recovery daemon
sshRecovery.checkedResult: Port1022 v4/v6 with key authentication enabled, password/kbd interactive disabled and cog only
sshRecovery.maintenanceRecommendation: Owner starts separately owned recovery daemon/unit, scopes firewall to existing administrative LAN sources if necessary, and verifies pinned-key SSH to1022 before upgrade; no daemon started by this lane

noninteractive.ROSCompatibilityWarning: Auto accepted; not evidence of ABI compatibility
noninteractive.conffile: Writes n to preserve installed file
noninteractive.ForceOverwrite: yes in signed config; installed-file collisions are separate from conffile policy
noninteractive.RemoveObsoletes: yes with PurgeObsoletes=yes default; package plan and removals accepted automatically
noninteractive.RealReboot: no default; not a whole migration guard
noninteractive.TerminalTimeout: 2400 seconds without activity, not a safe overall upgrade transaction deadline
noninteractive.recommendation: Prefer supervised Text in isolated tmux for this NVIDIA/ROS desktop; unattended systemd NI cannot review unexpected removal decisions

config.optionalCleanupDeferral: [Distro] RemoveObsoletes=no disables post-upgrade obsolete cleanup only; does not block dependency-resolver required removals
config.thirdParty: Default disables unsupported third-party sources; do not enable allow-third-party or globally substitute jammy feed names
config.packageState: apt-clone_system_state.tar.gz is scrub_sources=True with protected umask; package/config recovery metadata, not full-home data backup

vendorAndROS.retention: Signed removal denylist includes openssh-server and desktop metapackages, no generic guarantee for NVIDIA or ROS; review actual selected removal/add/upgrade plan
vendorAndROS.nvidia: Installed580.178.04 requires target kernel modules/DKMS plus matching user libraries; retain restore evidence and validate actual GPU/render/codec/GUI each intermediate reboot
vendorAndROS.ros: Humble Jammy cannot be declared valid on Noble by retaining packages or accepting warning; preserve package/version/workspace evidence, use the already tested matching ABI containers, and rebuild native targets for the adopted release
vendorAndROS.reenable: Only reviewed distro-supported sources after each upgrade; inventory installed and loaded versions separately

tmux.logging: Create protected owner runtime directory outside backed-up data set first; use pipe-pane for transcript plus /var/log/dist-upgrade raw logs. Attach logging before invoking upgrader so initial prompt is captured.
tmux.interactions: Read current pane and prompt then send one reviewed response; no blind yes stream or hard timeout killing dpkg

matches.text: def confirmChanges(self, summary, changes, demotions, downloadSize,
" ask a Yes/No question and return True on 'Yes' "
logging.debug("Skipping RemoveObsoletes as stated in the config")
